newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian electricity consumption falls in September.
newsitem.headline: Italian electricity consumption falls in September.

text.p: Italian electricity consumption in September fell a seasonally adjusted 0.3 percent compared to September 1995, according to preliminary data from state electricity utility ENEL.
On an unadjusted basis, electricity use fell 0.8 percent last month after a 0.9 percent year-on-year fall in August.
In the first nine months of this year, electricity consumption rose a seasonally adjusted 0.3 percent against the same period of 1995, and 0.7 percent on an unadjusted basis.
